interpretation: Compiler spread is empirical sensitivity, not a bound on valid inference. Use nine-decimal PA parameters for theta/rho/lambda, six-decimal RS times and LK likelihood. Printed precision limits zero-difference claims. Common-grid curves are piecewise constant log lambda on 256 logarithmically spaced interval-midpoint times from the original O2 fit. Interval-index error is also reported. LL is the legacy reported E-step likelihood, preceding the last M-step. No population-level validation is claimed.
